case.title: Change reminder timing
case.text: Hey, reminders go out 24h before but my clients forget anyway. Can I send one 2 hours before too?
case.why: Reminder timing how-to (up to three reminders per appointment).

output.reply:
Hi Lucas! Yes, you can add up to three reminders per appointment, so a second one 2 hours before works well. Here's how:

1. Go to Settings → Reminders.
2. Choose your channel: SMS, WhatsApp, or SMS + WhatsApp.
3. Under timing, add a second reminder at 2 hours before (keep your 24-hour one).
4. Edit the message template if you like. You can use placeholders such as {client_name}, {service}, {date} and {time}.
5. Click Save. New and existing future appointments will use the new settings.

A few notes: SMS and WhatsApp reminders use message credits, so check your balance in Settings → Billing → Message credits, because reminders pause when credits run out. Phone numbers need the country code (for example +55 11 90000 0000), or they are skipped. Also, an appointment booked less than 2 hours ahead won't get that reminder. You can check each reminder's status in Reports → Reminder log.

Note that multiple reminders with SMS/WhatsApp are available on the Pro plan and above. Let us know if you need anything else!
